say:2:1730305201:1.text: Can anyone guarantee she'll always make the right decisions?
say:2:1730305201:1.source_cn: 可谁又能保证她能一直正确下去？
say:2:1730305201:1.male: Can anyone guarantee she'll always make the right decisions?
say:2:1730305201:1.female: Can anyone guarantee she'll always make the right decisions?

say:3:1730305202:1.text: Until the next ruler is decided, we still have to rely on the council of nobles and elders.
say:3:1730305202:1.source_cn: 况且耀光的继承人一直没定，在一切尘埃落定之前，帝国仍需...
say:3:1730305202:1.male: Until the next ruler is decided, we still have to rely on the council of nobles and elders.
say:3:1730305202:1.female: Until the next ruler is decided, we still have to rely on the council of nobles and elders.

say:4:1730305203:1.text: Collective counsel and mutual oversight are necessary to ensure a smooth transition of power.
say:4:1730305203:1.source_cn: 群策群力，又能共同监督制衡，这样帝国的权力才能平稳过渡。
say:4:1730305203:1.male: Collective counsel and mutual oversight are necessary to ensure a smooth transition of power.
say:4:1730305203:1.female: Collective counsel and mutual oversight are necessary to ensure a smooth transition of power.
